claims.statement: Theogony organizes its Rust workspace into modular crates including theogony-domain for pure domain models and validation rules without database or UI dependencies.
Theogony-ports defines abstract storage traits implemented by theogony-db-sqlite to decouple domain logic from SQLite persistence, migrations, and transactional edit logs.
The frontend React application communicates with the Tauri-backed Rust host application via asynchronous IPC commands for local-first desktop execution.
Theogony uses a Cargo workspace organizing backend code into domain, ports, sqlite persistence, gedcom, ai, and tauri app crates.
The Tauri application crate manages host integration, Tauri IPC commands, application state, and window initialization.
Theogony-domain defines core genealogical entities, identifiers, and validation rules without database or UI dependencies.
Theogony-ports defines abstract traits and repository interfaces decoupling business logic from persistence engines.
Theogony-db-sqlite implements concrete SQLite storage, migrations, edit logging, and transactional repositories.
The React frontend in ui/ communicates asynchronously with the Rust backend via Tauri IPC commands and event listeners.
Theogony is a local-first genealogy desktop application built with a Tauri host, React frontend, SQLite persistence layer, and a domain-driven Rust crate workspace.
The Rust workspace is structured into specialized crates including theogony-domain, theogony-ports, theogony-db-sqlite, theogony-gedcom, theogony-ai, and theogony-app.
The React frontend communicates with the Rust backend exclusively via asynchronous Tauri IPC commands and event listeners.
Local-first data persistence is managed via SQLite databases with transaction and edit logging supporting audit trails, undo/redo capabilities, and branch merging.
